title: Three AI giants. One desktop. Who wins? #openai #google
description: The major players in artificial intelligence are racing to build unified desktop apps, mirroring Anthropic's claude ai app. This ai news highlights how OpenAI is merging ChatGPT and Codex into a single application, while Google is testing its google gemini app. These new desktop applications represent a significant step in ai automation, aiming to provide more functional ai tools for everyday use.
